subject: Computação
description_pt: Expor, argumentar e negociar propostas, produtos e serviços, utilizando diferentes mídias e ferramentas digitais.

components.description_pt: Selecionar mídias e ferramentas digitais apropriadas para apresentar proposta, produto ou serviço
components.description_en: Select appropriate media and digital tools for presenting a proposal, product, or service to a specific audience
components.cc_component_description: Select an appropriate communication format to convey scientific or technical ideas to a specific audience

components.description_pt: Construir apresentação de proposta, produto ou serviço usando mídias digitais
components.description_en: Construct a presentation of a proposal, product, or service using digital media
components.cc_component_description: Construct a persuasive data-supported presentation communicating how a design meets specified client needs

components.description_pt: Argumentar a favor de proposta, produto ou serviço usando evidências e estratégias persuasivas
components.description_en: Argue in favor of a proposal, product, or service using evidence and persuasive strategies
components.cc_component_description: Justify the choice of one design solution over others using evidence from criteria and constraint analysis

components.description_pt: Negociar termos ou aceitação de proposta respondendo a contra-argumentos em contexto digital
components.description_en: Negotiate terms or acceptance of a proposal by responding to counterarguments in a digital or multimodal context
components.cc_component_description: Identify and analyze counterarguments to a given scientific claim

cc_matches.description: Communicate scientific and/or technical information or ideas (e.g. about phenomena and/or the process of development and the design and performance of a proposed process or system) in multiple formats (including orally, graphically, textually, and mathematically).

Both physical models and computers can be used in various ways to aid in the engineering design process. Computers are useful for a variety of purposes, such as running simulations to test different ways of solving a problem or to see which one is most efficient or economical; and in making a persuasive presentation to a client about how a given design will meet his or her needs.
Generate and compare multiple possible solutions to a problem based on how well each is likely to meet the criteria and constraints of the problem.
